card.name: The letter u inside broken-up words
card.fires_on: The short piece "u" (often with a leading space) that starts or sits inside a word, mostly glued onto a heading or table label in drug-label text, e.g. UTI, Drug, uveal, ACR.

modes.label: u starting a heading
modes.description: A lone u opens an abbreviation or label right after a bullet or list marker.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION •<< u>>UTI: The recommended dosage of BL

modes.label: u inside split Drug
modes.description: A u sits in the middle of the word Drug in a table header where the text is spaced oddly.

modes.label: u stuck to the end of a phrase
modes.description: A u appears after a sentence or phrase end, before the next heading or word begins.
